$comment: The copies check's config (scripts/copies.mjs), as the starter kit writes it (setup/template/copies.json.tmpl). Each rule's mend is what a failure of it says (scripts/schemas.mjs).
mend: write the config as the starter kit does ({core}setup/template/copies.json.tmpl): a JSON object with "baseline", the baseline's path, "code" and "prose", lists of git pathspecs, and "proseFromSecurity": true or false

mendFor.additionalProperties: take it out; the config holds "baseline", "code", "prose", "proseFromSecurity", "tests" and "twice" alone
mendFor.required: name the baseline's path in "baseline", as the starter kit writes it ({core}setup/template/copies.json.tmpl)

baseline.mend: name the baseline's path in "baseline", as the starter kit writes it ({core}setup/template/copies.json.tmpl)

code.mend: write it as a list of git pathspecs, each a non-empty string

prose.mend: write it as a list of git pathspecs, each a non-empty string

proseFromSecurity.mend: set it to true, to read the project's rule files, or false

tests.mend: write it as a list of git pathspecs, each a non-empty string: the files that are tests, whose values the check leaves out (copies-values.mjs)

twice.mend: write it as an object of each value written in two files, a pin or a pattern as it stands, to why both must hold it, a non-empty string
